# Fourth-stage viability audit (generated by tools/hardcore/audit_viability.py, read-only)

Goal: every fourth stage is competitively viable. There are no abilities in Crystal, so viability here means stats, a strong STAB attack in the category of the better attacking stat, three or more coverage types in that category, and recovery or setup. Moves counted: every level-up move plus the TM/HM list. Charge, recharge and self-KO moves do not count as attacks.

38 of 62 forms have at least one flag.
